content.short: DeDust.io is an advanced AMM and DEX on TON, known for its gas efficiency and professional trading tools.
content.description: DeDust.io is a premier decentralized exchange (DEX) and automated market maker (AMM) built on the TON blockchain using the advanced DeDust Protocol 2.0. It is renowned for its exceptional gas efficiency and a highly polished user interface that caters to both casual swappers and professional traders. DeDust supports a wide array of token pairs, provides deep liquidity, and offers sophisticated tools for liquidity providers, making it a cornerstone of the TON DeFi ecosystem.
